content.title: Three French Police Officers Found Guilty of Racist Assault on Black Music Producer Michel Zecler
content.caption: Three French police officers were found guilty of beating a black music producer, Michel Zecler, in 2020. The incident sparked outrage over police brutality and racism.

slides.text: Three French police officers were found guilty of beating a black music producer, Michel Zecler, in 2020. The incident sparked outrage over police brutality and racism.

slides.heading: The Incident
slides.text: In 2020, three French police officers beat Michel Zecler, a black music producer, in his building. The incident was caught on security cameras and sparked outrage over police brutality and racism.

slides.heading: The Officers
slides.text: The three officers were Aurelien Lapersonne, 29; Pierre Plantier, 37; and Philippe Tondeux, 50. They were found guilty of intentional, racist violence.
